text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: There's still time before training, so maybe I'll work on the class log a bit~
choice_data_list: So you were on day duty today?
So you were on day duty today.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's how it was~
Erasing the blackboard was such hard work—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Umm, 'Today's Day Duty'... Hishi Miracle.
'Excused Absence' is Bamboo-chan.
And today's late arrivals are...?

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: "Tanino Gimlet... Late again, I see. You will write an apology letter for every single day you've been tardy—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Doc,
could you not hear 'that'?"

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: "Pardon?"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"It is the roar of the Starving Deity, emerging from beyond...!
Once it shakes the mind, it echoes in the soul,
awakening a hunger for flesh and blood...!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“――It's 'stone-roasted carrot.'
Want some too?”

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"No thank you!
Or rather, stop eating it alreadyyy!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, good times...
Why did I even get scolded over roasted carrots, though...?
Was lunchtime really not good enough~?
choice_data_list: (Going all out right from the morning...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The student who was late was 'Tanino Gimlet'...
'Period 1: Japanese Language', 'Period 2: Sports Science'...
...Right, right, in that dodgeball match—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"—Outstanding. ...Splendid.
To dodge... my ball."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"For a master of the Kongo Yaegaki style,
something like this is trivial.
...However, it seems my time has come."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "OK—next is—the finale."

text_block_list.name: Kris S & Yaeno
text_block_list.text:
"—Hmph!"
"—Hah!"

(――*whoosh!*)
(――*crash!*)
(――*KABOOM!*)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hey...
This is dodgeball, right...?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...M-Maybe?
Well, let's just stay off to the side."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was one fierce battle~
The balls even smashed into each other and broke at the end.
choice_data_list: (...Is this straight out of a manga??)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And next is 'Points to Reflect on Today', huh...
Reflections, reflections... If I had to say, maybe that thing?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "—So, I was thinking, how about we set up a food stall?! What do you all think?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, do we really need food stalls
just to expand the cafeteria menu~...?"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“Building a utopia, huh... Heh, fascinating!
Then leave crafting the stalls to me.
I'll recycle those broken fences to do it!”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ""?? Aluminum can... Korean lettuce...??""

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Permission.
—I need—the Chairwoman's permission."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Wait, are you going to go get it...?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "Taking on a challenge... is a good thing."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I agree!
Even if we mess up, it'll still make for a wonderful memory♪"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Then, Chris, maybe you can help me with the planning sheet, and Gimlet, could you build the food stall?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "I'd love to get your advice on the menu, Mirako-san, so let's chat again soon, okay? —See you later then♪"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Ah, yeah... Again...??"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Areas for improvement: 'Could not stop friend.'
And under 'Daily Comment'—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "I found a flower blooming with sheer guts at the edge of the grounds, and it totally cheered me up," and send.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's a wra~p.
Phew, I'm so beat~

Just hearing about it makes it sound
like quite an eventful day, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, no, this sort of thing
is just everyday business at this academy~
choice_data_list: Being late, dodgeball, lunch, stuff like that!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Everyone around me was making a big fuss,
but for me, it was pretty much a peaceful~ day.
choice_data_list: Your stamina held out well, didn't it...
Looks like this will really forge your mental strength.
Looks like it'll really train your mental strength.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Everyone around me was making a big fuss,
but for me, it was pretty much a peaceful~ day.
choice_data_list: Your stamina held out well, didn't it...
Looks like this will really forge your mental strength.
Looks like it'll really train your mental strength.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess so?
I got dragged into a bunch of stuff today,
so maybe I am kinda tired?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
! Huh, really~!?
I was just craving something sweet to drink~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Do you really think so?
I'm just watching from the outside, though~
choice_data_list: You can come here anytime you're tired.
You can come here anytime you're tired.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, really~?
Say things like that and I might just move in~ hehe!
